description: A training script for the DETR object detection model, extending Detectron2's training framework with custom evaluator, data loader, and optimizer setup.

classes.name: Trainer
classes.description: Extension of the Detectron2 DefaultTrainer class, customized for DETR training with methods for building evaluators, data loaders, and optimizers.

methods.name: build_evaluator
methods.description: Creates a COCOEvaluator for a specified dataset, with output folder for inference results.

methods.name: build_train_loader
methods.description: Builds the training data loader, using DetrDatasetMapper if the architecture is 'Detr'.

methods.name: build_optimizer
methods.description: Sets up the optimizer with parameter groups, supports gradient clipping, and handles different optimizer types.
